reviewer: A reviewer who has not seen the code

reasons.phone: At 12 m the shot is a pair of glass doors under a brown band and the canopy's edge; nothing names an airport. The cream fascia and the green board are blank in every render. Not named in one look and barely on a second.
reasons.silhouette: The front's long glass wall and both sides' canopy on columns say a terminal front; the back is a blank brown box with two doors: about two of four.
reasons.proportion: Door height, the canopy at about 5 m and its columns agree with the person.
reasons.palette: Palette only; the glass is the dark palette colour as assets:flat-and-smooth-shading asks, but the back, sides and roof are one flat dull brown.
reasons.wear: A clean box: a few roof units and three fascia blocks. No AC condensers, stains, bollards, signs, trolleys bay or barrier at the kerb.
reasons.variety: Plainly its own (the only large modern building) and in the same flat palette family.
reasons.budget: Read from the register row: triangles 954 of 1,500 (63%), draw calls 1 of 1 (100%), materials 1 of 1 (100%), bytes 7,352 of 40,000 (18%). Inside every figure, over 80% on at least one.

notes: In the place shots the terminal is dressed by the place (check-in boards, trolleys, taxis, the flag), which is why the airport reads there; the piece alone does not.
